category_title: Energetic child with autism using AAC and exhibiting behavioral protests
scenario_title: Making refined choices using a personalized photo menu during breakfast
minimal_context: Adam is sitting at a table with his teacher to select breakfast items using a personalized photo menu.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is breakfast time. Here are the pictures of food and drinks on the table.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Picks up a picture of cranberry juice and gives it to the teacher.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Here is your juice. What do you want to eat?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Taps the picture for toast and Nutella. While waiting, he moves his head closer to the teacher and looks directly into his eyes.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You finished your toast. Now you need to choose just one item from your book.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Reaches for his book, turns the page, and chooses both cereal and toast. He pushes both pictures forward, showing his strong views about what he wants, and begins to protest intensely when he cannot have both.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: It is breakfast time. Here are the pictures of food and drinks on the table.

STUDENT: (Picks up a picture of cranberry juice and gives it to the teacher.)

TUTOR: Here is your juice. What do you want to eat?

STUDENT: (Taps the picture for toast and Nutella. While waiting, he moves his head closer to the teacher and looks directly into his eyes.)

TUTOR: You finished your toast. Now you need to choose just one item from your book.

STUDENT: (Reaches for his book, turns the page, and chooses both cereal and toast. He pushes both pictures forward, showing his strong views about what he wants, and begins to protest intensely when he cannot have both.)

task.content: Selecting breakfast items using a personalized photo menu
task.learning_goal: Communicate choices and understand expectations to choose just one item

context.materials: Individually designed breakfast menu with photographs of a range of food and drinks, book

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When the teacher responded that he needed to choose just one item after he had already eaten
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Reached for his book, turned the page and chose cereal and toast
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Clear and often strong views about how he wanted to spend his time

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Looked at his teacher, moving his head closer to the teacher and looking directly into his eyes
Tapped the picture and gave it to his teacher
